name: AWS DevSecOps evidence artifacts
description: The 45 evidence artifacts an AWS DevSecOps system produces, each listed against the NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls it evidences. Adapted from m365-docs-hub's required-artifact table, with its control mappings corrected, missing network, API and identity artifacts added, and log retention set to OMB M-21-31. Lists what to collect; it does not collect anything.
